newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Wednesday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said there was less short-term money supply on the market today, which supported early-maturing contracts.

"Some financial institutions which used to lend out large amounts of money released less today," said one trader. "Rumours said they were keeping money to prepare for some new treasury bond issues in the short term." Officials declined to comment.

"With less fund available, the market rates are likely to stabilise in the next few days," said a second trader. "But state-banks are expected to continue to lend out money due to a short-term money surplus at the national level."
